goals.text: Complete at least 1 TinaCMS v4 PBI - Forms System Rebuild - Form Hooks (tinacms#6912) and Persistent Zustand Stores/Events (tinacms#6913) both closed, taking the v4 Forms System Rebuild epic from 3/6 to 5/6

Complete at least 1 WorkOS migration PBI - Self-heal a stale Verified flag on the WorkOS path (tinacloud#4143) closed and the upcoming auth changes email (tinacloud#4124) went out, the Auth Migration epic moved from 24/36 to 26/35, and the Cognito to WorkOS dry-run (tinacloud#4138) is still under way

sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-125/health.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview - Identity API HTTP 500s increased from 20 to 339. Content API HTTP 500s dropped from 733 to 263 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-125/commits.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 39,667 (up 10% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-125/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - our conversion metric is the share who go on to commit. New accounts were 13% last Sprint and are now 8% (10 of 131). Invited collaborators were 22% and are now 26% (29 of 113) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-125/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 133 new organisations, up from 128 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-125/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 668 on 22 Sep (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-125/geo.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the past 30 days - US is our top country based on user-base with 1,749, ahead of Germany on 598 and the UK on 475 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)
